EmailTemplate.subject: Last chance to register... {Webinar} Tips & tools for enhancing IT & finance collaboration
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Join our webinar today “Embracing Change: Tips & tools for enhancing IT & finance collaboration <[[https://www.flywire.com/resources/webinar-embracing-change-tips-tools-for-enhancing-it-finance-collaboration]]>" where we will discuss newly released IT research with finance and IT leaders from Tennessee State University that will explore how automation and change tactics are helping to drive smoother collaboration and system integration.
Attendees can expect tips and tools on:
- Creating operational efficiencies that enable staff to save time & money, - Optimizing the payment process for the payer and the institution, - And increasing cash flow by keeping more students enrolled.
